name: Ultra Realism
about: Photoreal lighting + PBR textures + far terrain. Patrix and rotrBLOCKS with Complementary Unbound is the most-recommended free realism stack.

name: Horror
about: Spooklementary: crushing fog, pitch-black caves, eyes in the dark. Herobrine-led zombies, realistic mobs, blinking ender eyes, whispers in caves, over Patrix's realistic blocks. Distant Horizons off so the fog closes in.

name: Halloween
about: Stylised, not realistic: Mojang's Halloween Mash-up, Default-style Halloween and The Night of the Living Pumpkins over vanilla-like Complementary Reimagined.

name: Christmas
about: Mojang's Festive Mash-up winter wonderland, present chests all year, Santa hats, snowy leaves and frosted foliage under BSL's soft light.

name: Minecraft Trailer
about: The 'Trailer Vibes' recipe: Bare Bones textures (Mojang's promo-art style) + Fresh Animations + their compatibility patch, lit by BSL.
